messages:
anya: quick follow-up from the postmortem  consolidating owners for the token TTL drift, audit gaps, and the outstanding secret rotations. keeping this thread tight.
sarah: good. i'll take audit pipeline fixes and verify audit event coverage post-rotate. will also draft the verification checklist.
mike: i'll own token TTL detection and the CI smoke. plan: daily job + small dashboard + PD if >1% violations.
julia: i'll coordinate the bulk secret rotate run and maintenance notice. prefer saturday 03:00 PT low-traffic window.
anya: suggested TTL policy: interactive/user tokens <=30d, service tokens <=7d, short-lived machine tokens <=24h. i'll add to runbook.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4890  audit retention + pipeline fixes (https://tracker.redwood/INFRA-4890)
sarah: audit gaps: observed missing rotation events from authz-service and sampling enabled on edge-proxies for some nodes. created ENG-6044 and ENG-6045.
eng-security: ENG-6044 assigned to authz team; ENG-6045 assigned to platform-edge. linked to INFRA-4890.
mike: CI snippet i'll add:
```bash
# token-ttl-smoke
python infra/check_token_ttl.py --env prod --service-ttl 7 --user-ttl 30
```
Going to add a Grafana panel for drift percent and a PD policy for >1% failing.
julia: secrets inventory shows 11 flagged keys across prod/staging. i'll publish the rotation plan and rollback steps. aiming for 2026-04-18 03:00 PT.
sarah: pre-rotate checklist draft: 1) map consumers 2) ensure no direct secret mounts 3) snapshot audit logs 4) notify downstream owners. will attach to INFRA-4890.
mike: note for SDK teams: credential refresh semantics might need small client-side grace on rotation. i'll open a docs PR and tag client owners.
anya: action summary to add to remediation tracker sheet:
- mike: implement token TTL detector + CI + PD (due 2026-04-05)
- sarah: audit pipeline fix + verification checklist + retention bump (due 2026-03-31)
- julia: execute bulk secret rotate + post-rotate verification (due 2026-04-18)
- anya: finalize TTL policy in runbook and notify product/security (due 2026-03-28)
sarah: linking tasks to remediation board: https://docs.redwood/remediation/2026-q2-sweep
mike: quick Q  which services had missing events? authz-service and some edge-proxy nodes.
anya: confirmed. authz regression filtered rotation events, edge-proxy had sampling toggled accidentally. ENG-6044/ENG-6045 cover these.
eng-security: noted. will review post-rotate audit snapshots and confirm coverage.
anya: unless there are objections i'll close this thread and track progress in the remediation board. re-open here if blockers appear :thumbsup:
